detail.command:
LOG=/private/tmp/claude-501/-/878caa08-6b06-497e-8e8f-f501167a423a/scratchpad
mkdir -p "$LOG"
if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then echo 'installing deps'; npm install --no-audit --no-fund > "$LOG/npm-install.log" 2>&1 || { tail -40 "$LOG/npm-install.log"; exit 1; }; echo 'deps installed'; else echo 'node_modules present'; fi
npx vitest run src/obstacles > "$LOG/vitest-obstacles.log" 2>&1; code=$?
tail -60 "$LOG/vitest-obstacles.log"
echo "vitest exit: $code"
